traceability.notes:
The 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION story requires deep validation of requirement references: parsing story files, matching @req/@supports against actual requirements, supporting multiple formats and file structures, caching parsed content, integrating with existing rules, and providing clear, specific error messages.
Implementation analysis: - Core deep validation logic is encapsulated in `src/rules/helpers/valid-req-reference-helpers.ts` and wired via the `valid-req-reference` rule. This code: - Parses story files with a generic `REQ-[A-Z0-9-]+` regex across the entire Markdown file, which naturally supports headings, paragraphs, bullet lists, numbered lists, and acceptance criteria checkboxes without needing Markdown-aware parsing. - Maintains a per-Program `reqCache` to avoid re-reading and re-parsing story files during a single ESLint run, fulfilling REQ-DEEP-CACHE within the intended scope. - Validates each @req and each @supports requirement ID against the cached set and reports a clear `reqMissing` diagnostic when absent, satisfying REQ-DEEP-MATCH and REQ-DEEP-ERROR. - Validates story paths for traversal and absoluteness, reporting `invalidPath` where appropriate; this both protects against unsafe paths and integrates with path validation concerns of earlier stories. - Handles I/O and parsing issues gracefully via try/catch in `loadAndCacheRequirements`, never crashing ESLint, and degrading to reporting missing requirements instead.
Integration & quality: - The rule is exported and configured as part of the plugin (`src/index.ts`) and is included in recommended/strict presets. Tests confirm this configuration. - Tests in `tests/rules/valid-req-reference.test.ts` give strong coverage of both positive and negative scenarios, including bullet-form requirements and multi-story `@supports` annotations using dedicated fixtures. - User documentation `docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md` clearly documents the deep validation behavior, including examples of supported formats and error cases, aligned with the story's requirements.
Given the concrete implementation, passing tests, and documentation, all acceptance criteria of docs/stories/010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION.story.md are satisfied in the current codebase, even though some checkboxes in the story file remain unchecked. Therefore this story is assessed as PASSED.
